selection: minimum SHA256(deltadom-outcome-v1/task_id/variant) per environment, all variants eligible; previously inspected gmail_star_email excluded
model_channel: WorkBuddy Deepseek-V4.1-Flash; ChatGPT Desktop if available
hypothesis: Attach a fresh UI read to the existing native action only after observed HTTP writes complete; avoid new tools, contracts and model-directed verification detours.
strong_control: auto-control attaches the same read after every non-link click; macro-simple has the same sidecar acquisition and native batching. No private response content, endpoint-specific rules or retry loop.
criterion: Equal or better task completion and false-success behavior at equal primitive budget; fewer model requests is secondary. Compare against the strongest working control; do not credit an inactive mechanism.
run_order: retain original seven tasks and both conditions in order; development includes prior Gmail and Amazon cases, not held-out. No task replacements; every unexecuted cell remains not_run.
